title: MFA verification
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: High-fidelity desktop multi-factor authentication verification screen for Olentra Technologies.
Generate a BRAND-NEW landscape desktop interface approximately16:10, crisp straight-on UI screenshot. Use near-black navy #070b12, slate card surfaces, fine subtle borders, vivid blue #2563EB primary button, white headings, silver supporting text, large legible sans-serif typography, spacious enterprise style. Opaque background, no device frame, no collage.
This is a SIGNED-OUT verification screen, not a dashboard. There MUST NOT be any sidebar, application navigation, dashboard top bar, breadcrumb, notifications, environment selector, Global selector, Owner label, signed-in user or avatar.
Layout: a two-column split screen. Left brand panel approximately45percent of screen with dark navy, restrained abstract blue arcs in lower half, large "OLENTRA" wordmark at upper left with smaller "TECHNOLOGIES". Center-left heading "A second step. Stronger access." Supporting line "Verify your identity to continue to your workspace." Small "Olentra Technologies" footer. No external provider logos or fabricated certifications.
Right side centered slate authentication card. Small badge "CONCEPT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA". Simple shield icon. Heading "Verify it’s you". Supporting text "Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app." Six large equal square code input boxes in a single row, all EMPTY, first box with blue focus border and small caret. No actual verification codes or tokens. Unselected checkbox with label "Trust this device for 7 days". Wide vivid blue primary button "Verify & continue". Below, clear link "Use a recovery code", horizontal divider, and left-arrow "Back to sign in" link. Small muted note "Codes refresh in your authenticator app." Card content centered and readable. Footer outside card has links "Privacy" and "Terms".
Constraints: build the signed-out page from scratch without application chrome. No real email addresses, phone numbers, personal names or user avatars. No unsupported encryption promises. Consistent dark navy/blue authentication visual language. All key text correct and legible. Do not show filled codes, QR codes, secrets or recovery tokens.
notes: High-fidelity signed-out authentication design, concept/sample data; built-in image generation.
